sources.title: MAC Address Lookup Tool - AskApache
sources.snippet: Discover which company built a networked interface by MAC Address. Several formats accepted: 00-1C-23-59-5A-92, 001c23595a92, 00:1C:23:59:5A:92 Partial searches are accepted: 001c, 2359:92 Uses several databases including NMAP, IEEE Official List, Wireshark Info, and more.
